ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a high-contrast ratio of approximately 94:6 dark-to-light pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark base pigmentation with discrete high-contrast white annular blobs (10-30 pixels in diameter) localized in the medial-left, central-medial, and clustered heavily in the mid-right region of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 148 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of 0.12 relative to the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 4 to 12 pixels between adjacent peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex sweep from the central notch to the distal tips, following a parabolic curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, ring-shaped white pixel clusters (annular rosettes) distributed across both lobes, with a specific high-density cluster on the right medial lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, thin, high-intensity linear pixel streaks (approx. 50-80 pixels in length) oriented diagonally on the left distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular serration and localized pixel loss at the distal tips (ragged edges); presence of numerous white circular barnacle attachment scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'bullseye' scar pattern characterized by dark-pixel centers surrounded by high-intensity white rings located at the right-mid lobe quadrant.
